menu.title: WWII Card Clash
menu.generateCodePrompt: Click above to generate room code

rules.rule4_1: The battlefield is divided into three layers:

game.timeUp: Time's up! Command has ordered a retreat.
game.campaignVictory: 🎉 Campaign Victory! Advanced card reward unlocked.
game.meleeSupportLineTarget: Melee units in the support line can only attack enemy frontline units!
game.mustEnterFrontlineToAttackHq: Must enter frontline to attack enemy HQ!
game.cannotMoveEnemyControl: Cannot move, enemy might control the frontline!
game.interceptedV1: Enemy fighter successfully intercepted the V1 missile!

deckBuilder.title: 🛠️ Deck Builder
deckBuilder.maxCardsLimit: Deck can contain up to 60 cards!
deckBuilder.maxAdvancedLimit: You can only carry up to 2 advanced cards!
deckBuilder.confirmSavePart2: cards (standard is 60). Are you sure you want to save? The system will randomly fill the missing cards during the game.
deckBuilder.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear the current deck?
deckBuilder.emptyDeckMsg: Deck is empty, please select cards from the left to add.

unit_1.name: Conscript
unit_1.desc: Basic infantry in massive numbers, equipped with Mosin-Nagant rifles.
unit_1.exclusiveDesc: For every Conscript on the field, all friendly low-cost units gain +1 ATK (max 3 stacks per turn). Upon death, summons a free 1-cost Conscript token with no abilities.

unit_2.name: Guards Rifle Division
unit_2.desc: Battle-hardened elite infantry with an unbreakable will to fight.
unit_2.exclusiveDesc: When HP is below 50%, gains 30% damage reduction and cannot be priority targeted by enemy ambush units. If adjacent to friendly Soviet units, the Guard effect expands to the entire friendly frontline.

unit_3.name: Commissar
unit_3.desc: "Not one step back!" Boosts troop morale.
unit_3.exclusiveDesc: All friendly Soviet infantry gain +2 ATK and suffer no negative effects upon death. Once per turn, allows a low-HP friendly infantry unit to act immediately.

unit_4.name: T-34/76 Medium Tank
unit_4.desc: A perfect combination of sloped armor and mobility; the backbone of Soviet armor.
unit_4.exclusiveDesc: Refunds 2 CP when destroyed. For every T-34 series tank on the field, all friendly medium armor units gain a slight boost to movement and attack speed.

unit_5.name: T-34/85 Medium Tank
unit_5.desc: An upgraded T-34 equipped with an 85mm gun, capable of countering German heavy armor.
unit_5.exclusiveDesc: Inherits 'Mass Production' effect, and additionally deals 20% armor-piercing damage to enemy heavy armor.

unit_6.name: IS-2 Heavy Tank
unit_6.desc: A steel behemoth armed with a 122mm main gun, built specifically to destroy German heavy armor.
unit_6.exclusiveDesc: Damage against enemy structures and heavy armor is increased by 50%. Gains a shield on the turn it is deployed.

unit_7.name: SU-85 Self-Propelled Gun
unit_7.desc: Powerful anti-tank firepower capable of piercing armor from a long distance.
unit_7.exclusiveDesc: When Ambush is triggered, prioritizes enemy armor units, dealing critical damage to medium and heavy tanks.

unit_8.name: IL-2 Sturmovik
unit_8.desc: The "Flying Tank", an absolute weapon for ground attack.
unit_8.exclusiveDesc: Damage against ground units is doubled. Takes 40% less damage from ground attacks.

unit_9.name: Katyusha Rocket Launcher
unit_9.desc: Unleashes a terrifying howl during salvos, providing immense area-of-effect firepower.
unit_9.exclusiveDesc: Deals AoE damage. Inflicts continuous burn damage to the entire enemy frontline, ignoring light armor.

unit_10.name: KV-1 Heavy Tank
unit_10.desc: A mobile fortress in the early stages of the war; German anti-tank guns are useless against it.
unit_10.exclusiveDesc: Taunts all enemy attacking units upon deployment. Takes half damage from long-range artillery.

unit_11.name: Volkssturm
unit_11.desc: Late-war militia. Lacking training but equipped with Panzerfaust anti-tank weapons.
unit_11.exclusiveDesc: Low-cost sacrificial unit. Can be actively sacrificed to grant a high-tier friendly unit a massive stat boost for the turn.

unit_12.name: Wehrmacht Infantry
unit_12.desc: Highly trained regular army with excellent tactical skills.
unit_12.exclusiveDesc: While on the field, all friendly units gain 100% hit rate with no misses.

unit_13.name: Waffen-SS Panzergrenadier
unit_13.desc: Fanatical elite infantry that rapidly assaults alongside armored units.
unit_13.exclusiveDesc: When on the field with friendly German armor units, both gain significantly increased attack and movement speed. Restores a small amount of HP upon scoring a kill.

unit_14.name: Panzer IV Medium Tank
unit_14.desc: The absolute backbone of the German armored forces, active on all fronts.
unit_14.exclusiveDesc: Has no stat weaknesses. While on the field, steadily boosts the ATK and DEF of all friendly medium armor units.

unit_15.name: Panther Medium Tank
unit_15.desc: Boasts excellent firepower and frontal armor with outstanding performance.
unit_15.exclusiveDesc: Attacks ignore 50% of enemy heavy armor damage reduction. Naturally counters Soviet and British/French heavy tanks.

unit_16.name: Tiger Heavy Tank
unit_16.desc: The nightmare of the Allies, famous for its thick armor and 88mm main gun.
unit_16.exclusiveDesc: Taunts all enemy units upon deployment. Single-instance damage taken cannot exceed 30% of its max HP.

unit_17.name: Sd.Kfz. 251 Halftrack
unit_17.desc: An armored vehicle for rapid infantry deployment.
unit_17.exclusiveDesc: Restores HP to adjacent friendly units every turn after deployment, and increases the advance speed of the friendly frontline.

unit_18.name: 88mm Flak Gun
unit_18.desc: Not just for anti-air, but a deadly anti-tank weapon.
unit_18.exclusiveDesc: In AA mode, instantly destroys enemy low/mid-cost aircraft. In AT mode, can pierce all medium armor.

unit_19.name: Bf-109 Fighter
unit_19.desc: The mainstay fighter of the Luftwaffe, key to air superiority.
unit_19.exclusiveDesc: Prioritizes enemy air units. Can act again this turn after destroying an aircraft.

unit_20.name: Ju-87 Stuka
unit_20.desc: Dive bomber with a terrifying siren, capable of pinpoint strikes on ground targets.
unit_20.exclusiveDesc: Dive attacks trigger critical hits and reduce the ATK of all enemy units on the next turn upon a successful hit.

unit_21.name: G.I.
unit_21.desc: American soldiers equipped with M1 Garands, boasting ample firepower.
unit_21.exclusiveDesc: When all friendly G.I.s are destroyed, there is a chance they will freely respawn.

unit_22.name: Rangers
unit_22.desc: Elite assault infantry specializing in behind-enemy-lines operations.
unit_22.exclusiveDesc: Upon successful ambush, ignores enemy Guard effects and instantly kills enemy low-cost core units.

unit_23.name: M4 Sherman
unit_23.desc: A mass-produced medium tank known for its strong reliability.
unit_23.exclusiveDesc: Low cost and fast production. For every Sherman on the field, the damage of all friendly units permanently increases slightly.

unit_24.name: M26 Pershing
unit_24.desc: A heavy tank deployed late in the war, capable of facing Tigers and Panthers.
unit_24.exclusiveDesc: Clears all friendly negative effects upon deployment. Deals extra true damage to high-tier German armor units.

unit_25.name: M7 Priest SPG
unit_25.desc: Self-propelled artillery providing supporting fire for armored units.
unit_25.exclusiveDesc: Automatically deals minor AoE damage to the enemy backline every turn, continuously suppressing enemy damage dealers and support units.

unit_26.name: P-51 Mustang
unit_26.exclusiveDesc: While on the field, all friendly air units gain increased damage reduction and cannot be targeted by enemy ambush or raid units.

unit_27.name: B-17 Flying Fortress
unit_27.desc: A strategic heavy bomber with an extremely sturdy fuselage and dense defensive firepower.
unit_27.exclusiveDesc: Attacks ignore enemy ground defenses and deal direct damage to the enemy HQ. Area bombing clears out clustered enemy backline units.

unit_28.name: Tommy
unit_28.exclusiveDesc: All friendly units in the same row gain 15% damage reduction, creating a sturdy frontline at a low cost.

unit_29.name: Red Devils Paratroopers
unit_29.desc: Elite airborne troops ready to drop behind enemy lines at any time.
unit_29.exclusiveDesc: Can ignore enemy frontline Guards and directly attack enemy backline damage dealers and artillery.

unit_30.name: Crusader Cruiser Tank
unit_30.desc: An extremely fast cruiser tank active in the North African campaign.
unit_30.exclusiveDesc: Can retreat to avoid damage after attacking. Movement speed drastically increases at low HP, excelling at hit-and-run tactics.

unit_31.name: Churchill Infantry Tank
unit_31.desc: Features extremely thick armor but advances slowly.
unit_31.exclusiveDesc: Immune to sustained and burn damage. Its ultra-thick armor is perfect for soaking damage and steady advancement.

unit_32.name: 25-Pounder Howitzer
unit_32.desc: The iconic light field artillery of the British Army.
unit_32.exclusiveDesc: Attacks can lock onto low-HP enemy units to finish them off, while slightly degrading enemy armor.

unit_33.name: Spitfire Fighter
unit_33.desc: The legend of the Battle of Britain.
unit_33.exclusiveDesc: Gains a massive stat boost when fighting the Luftwaffe. Grants a temporary shield after shooting down an enemy aircraft.

unit_34.name: Lancaster Bomber
unit_34.desc: The workhorse of RAF Bomber Command, featuring a massive payload.
unit_34.exclusiveDesc: Features a massive bombing radius that hits both enemy frontline and backline simultaneously, excelling at suppressing clustered enemies.

unit_35.name: Foreign Legion
unit_35.desc: Elite soldiers of the Foreign Legion.
unit_35.exclusiveDesc: The fewer friendly units on the field, the higher its damage reduction and ATK. Extremely resilient in desperate situations.

unit_36.name: SOMUA S35 Cavalry Tank
unit_36.desc: An excellent tank balancing mobility and armor.
unit_36.exclusiveDesc: On the turn it is deployed, ignores enemy terrain and blockers, and can directly charge into the enemy half of the field.

unit_37.name: B1 Heavy Tank
unit_37.desc: One of the strongest European tanks before the war.
unit_37.exclusiveDesc: A single attack can strike two enemy units simultaneously, combining heavy armor with dual-line damage.

unit_38.name: Free French Partisans
unit_38.desc: Resistance forces conducting sabotage behind enemy lines.
unit_38.exclusiveDesc: Cannot be targeted while stealthed. Attacks reduce enemy attack and movement speed, continuously tying down enemy forces.

unit_39.name: 25-Pounder Howitzer
unit_39.exclusiveDesc: While stationary, damage and range continuously increase. The longer it holds the line, the stronger its output.

unit_40.name: Spitfire Fighter
unit_40.exclusiveDesc: Damage is massively increased when fighting alongside friendly partisan units.

order_41.name: Zhukov's Resolve
order_41.desc: [High Command] The Supreme Command orders a general offensive! All friendly units gain +5 ATK and +5 HP.

order_42.name: Guderian's Armored Spearhead
order_42.desc: [High Command] Break the limits! All friendly units regain action status, gain +3 ATK, and acquire Heavy Armor.

order_43.name: Manhattan Project
order_43.desc: [High Command] The ultimate weapon! Deals 12 devastating damage directly to the enemy HQ.

order_44.name: Harsh Winter
order_44.desc: Environment Card: At the start of each turn, all frontline units take 1 damage.

order_45.name: Rasputitsa (Mud Season)
order_45.desc: Environment Card: The CP cost for all armored units to move to the frontline is increased by 1.

order_46.name: Urban Warfare
order_46.desc: Environment Card: At the start of each turn, all infantry units gain +1 ATK.

order_47.name: Tactical Resupply
order_47.desc: Draw 2 cards and restore 3 HP to the HQ.

order_48.name: Suppressing Fire
order_48.desc: Deal 2 damage to all enemy units in the support line.

order_49.name: Combat Engineering: Minefield
order_49.desc: Tactical Deployment: Deploy an Anti-Tank Mine in the support line (deals extreme ambush damage).

order_50.name: Anti-Tank Mine
order_50.desc: A concealed anti-tank weapon that deals devastating damage upon triggering an ambush.

order_51.name: Combat Engineering: Sandbags
order_51.desc: Tactical Deployment: Deploy a Sandbag Bunker in the support line (features Guard and high HP).

order_52.name: Sandbag Bunker
order_52.desc: A sturdy defensive fortification that draws enemy fire.

order_53.name: Field Hospital
order_53.desc: Emergency Aid! Restore 8 HP to the HQ.

order_54.name: Ura Charge
order_54.desc: All-out counterattack! All friendly units on the field gain +2 ATK and +1 HP.

order_55.name: Katyusha Barrage
order_55.desc: Artillery coverage! Deal 3 damage to all enemy units.

order_56.name: Field First Aid
order_56.desc: Emergency Aid! Restore 8 HP to the HQ.

order_57.name: Blitzkrieg
order_57.desc: Armored Assault! Draw 2 cards, restore action status to all friendly units, and gain 2 CP.

order_58.name: V-1 Flying Bomb
order_58.desc: Early cruise missile. Deal 4 damage to the enemy HQ. If the enemy has air units on the field, there is a 50% chance it is intercepted (deals no damage).

order_59.name: V-2 Rocket
order_59.desc: Strategic Strike! Ignore the frontline and deal 6 damage directly to the enemy HQ.

order_60.name: Medical Airdrop
order_60.desc: Emergency Aid! Restore 8 HP to the HQ.

order_61.name: B-17 Carpet Bombing
order_61.desc: Air Strike! Deal 4 damage to all enemy units in the support line.

order_62.name: Logistical Superiority
order_62.desc: Mighty industrial capacity! Draw 3 cards and gain 3 CP.

order_63.name: Red Cross
order_63.desc: Emergency Aid! Restore 8 HP to the HQ.

order_64.name: Radar Early Warning
order_64.desc: Early Deployment! Draw 2 cards and all friendly units gain +1 DEF.

order_65.name: Royal Navy Support
order_65.desc: Naval Bombardment! Deal 4 damage to all enemy units.

order_66.name: Free French Medical Team
order_66.desc: Emergency Aid! Restore 8 HP to the HQ.

order_67.name: Maginot Line
order_67.desc: Heavily Fortified! Restore 5 HP to the HQ, and all friendly units gain Heavy Armor (+2 DEF).

order_68.name: Resistance Movement
order_68.desc: Behind-Enemy-Lines Sabotage! Deal 2 damage to 3 random enemy units.

order_69.name: Normandy Landings (Omaha Beach)
order_69.desc:
June 6, 1944. The Allies land in Normandy. The Germans have deployed sturdy bunkers on the cliffs.
Objective: Break through the Atlantic Wall and destroy the German HQ within 15 turns!
Reward: Unlock Advanced Card [101st Airborne Division]

order_70.name: Atlantic Wall Bunker
order_70.desc: A sturdy concrete fortification that cannot attack.

order_71.name: Battle of Stalingrad
order_71.desc:
Winter 1942. The German 6th Army launches a massive offensive. The city is reduced to rubble, and the environment is extremely harsh.
Objective: Destroy the German HQ within 20 turns.
Reward: Unlock Advanced Card [Stalingrad Guards Division]

order_72.name: Wehrmacht Infantry
order_72.desc: German infantry advancing into the ruins.

order_73.name: Battle of Kursk (Clash of Steel)
order_73.desc:
Summer 1943. The largest tank battle in history. Both HQs will receive a large amount of initial CP, but only armored units can be fully utilized.
Objective: Destroy the enemy HQ within 15 turns.
Reward: Unlock Advanced Card [King Tiger Heavy Tank]

order_74.name: Torrent of Steel
order_74.desc: Environment Card: All infantry units immediately take 5 damage upon deployment.

order_75.name: Battle of Britain
order_75.desc:
Autumn 1940. The Luftwaffe conducts massive bombing raids on the British mainland; the RAF rises to fight back. Fight for air superiority!
Objective: Defend your HQ and destroy the enemy within 15 turns.
Reward: Unlock Advanced Card [SAS]

order_76.name: Struggle for Air Superiority
order_76.desc: Environment Card: All air units gain +2 ATK.

commander_77.name: Georgy Zhukov
commander_77.passiveDesc: At the start of each turn, restore 1 HP to the HQ.
commander_77.activeDesc: Cost: 6 CP. All friendly units on the field gain +1 ATK and +1 HP.

commander_78.name: Erwin Rommel
commander_78.passiveDesc: At the start of each turn, gain 1 additional CP.
commander_78.activeDesc: Cost: 5 CP. All friendly armored units gain [Blitz].

commander_79.name: George S. Patton
commander_79.passiveDesc: All your infantry units gain +1 ATK upon deployment.
commander_79.activeDesc: Cost: 7 CP. Deal 2 damage to all enemy units on the field.

commander_80.name: Bernard Montgomery
commander_80.passiveDesc: At the start of each turn, if you have a unit on the frontline, restore 2 HP to the HQ.

commander_81.name: Charles de Gaulle
commander_81.passiveDesc: When HQ HP is below 10, draw 1 additional card at the start of each turn.
commander_81.activeDesc: Cost: 4 CP. Restore 5 HP to the HQ.
